# Support export, trimmed. The middle column is the ticket system's own
# reference, which happens to be written three, two and four digits.
ticket,reference,status
4471,000-41-1193,closed
4472,000-52-8840,open
4473,000528840,open

# Identity checks are handled elsewhere, and this export carries no such field.
#
# A number written after the word is not read as that word's value:
4474,000-63-2201,"no ssn on file"

last four only, which is how a support tool shows one -- ssn: ***-**-6789
